location.zh: 楓灣語言學院，204 教室

goal.en: Arrive late to class and apologize the right way.
goal.zh: 上課遲到了，用對的方式道歉。

background: classroom on a rainy morning with rows of desks, a whiteboard wiped clean, wet umbrellas leaning by the door, rain streaking down the tall windows, gray soft light

intro.en: It's pouring rain, and your bus was twenty minutes late.
intro.zh: 外面下著大雨，你搭的公車晚了二十分鐘。

intro.en: You open the classroom door. Everyone turns to look at you.
intro.zh: 你推開教室門，所有人都轉頭看你。

choices.tip: 上課中遲到，簡短道歉後安靜入座就好，不要打斷課程。

choices.en: I'm so sorry! Let me explain everything.
choices.zh: 真的很抱歉！讓我解釋一下。

lines.en: Maybe after class? We're in the middle of a quiz.
lines.zh: 要不要下課再說？我們正在小考。

story.en: The whole class hears the full story of the bus, the rain and your wet socks. Nobody finishes the quiz on time.
story.zh: 全班聽完了公車、大雨和你濕襪子的完整故事。結果沒人準時寫完小考。

fail.why: 在台灣，遲到常會當場長篇解釋表示誠意，但在英語課堂上，這會打斷上課。先簡短說 Sorry I'm late.，下課再解釋。

choices.en: Hi, everyone! What did I miss?
choices.zh: 嗨，大家好！我錯過了什麼？

lines.en: You missed the start of the quiz. Please sit down.
lines.zh: 你錯過了小考的開頭。請坐下。

story.en: Your cheerful entrance gets a few laughs, but not from Ms. Reed. She adds a note next to your name.
story.zh: 你開心的登場引來幾聲笑，但瑞德老師沒笑。她在你名字旁邊做了個記號。

fail.why: 遲到時開心地打招呼，聽起來像不在乎遲到。先道歉：Sorry I'm late.，再安靜坐下。

lines.en: You sit down next to Leo.

lines.zh: 嘿，你全身都濕了！怎麼了？

choices.en: The bus was late, so I ran here.
choices.zh: 公車誤點，所以我一路跑過來。
choices.tip: 說過去發生的事要用過去式：was、ran。so 用來連接原因和結果。

choices.en: The bus is late, so I run here.
choices.zh: 公車誤點，所以我跑過來。

lines.en: You run here? Every day? In the rain?
lines.zh: 你跑來這裡？每天？下雨也跑？

story.en: Leo now thinks you run to school every day. He invites you to join a marathon next month.
story.zh: 里歐以為你每天都跑步上學，還邀你下個月一起去跑馬拉松。

fail.why: 現在式表示習慣，聽起來像你每天都跑來上課。已經發生的事要用過去式：The bus was late, so I ran here.。

choices.en: The bus was too slow. Rain very big.

lines.en: The rain is... big? Like, huge raindrops?
lines.zh: 雨很……大？是說雨滴很大顆嗎？

story.en: Leo imagines raindrops the size of golf balls. He spends the rest of class looking out the window.
story.zh: 里歐想像著高爾夫球那麼大的雨滴，剩下的課都在看窗外。

fail.why: 「雨很大」不是 rain very big。英文說 It's raining hard. 或 It's pouring.。說明遲到原因可以說 The bus was late, so I ran here.。

lines.en: After class, Ms. Reed waves you over.
lines.zh: 下課後，瑞德老師招手叫你過去。

lines.en: Kai, do you have a minute? What happened this morning?
lines.zh: 凱，有空嗎？今天早上怎麼了？

choices.en: Sorry. My bus was twenty minutes late.
choices.zh: 抱歉，我的公車晚了二十分鐘。
choices.tip: 先道歉，再用一句話說明原因。簡短、具體的解釋最有說服力。

choices.en: I'm sorry. Should I write a self-reflection?
choices.zh: 對不起。我需要寫悔過書嗎？

lines.en: A self-reflection? For being late once? No, no!
lines.zh: 悔過書？才遲到一次？不用、不用！

story.en: Ms. Reed laughs and says it's not a big deal. You still feel like you should bow three times.
story.zh: 瑞德老師笑著說沒什麼大不了。你還是覺得應該鞠躬三次才行。

fail.why: 台灣學校常有寫悔過書的習慣，但在國外，偶爾遲到只要道歉並說明原因：Sorry. My bus was twenty minutes late.。

choices.en: It's not my fault. Blame the bus.
choices.zh: 不是我的錯，要怪就怪公車。

lines.en: Hmm. The bus isn't in my class, Kai. You are.
lines.zh: 嗯……公車不是我的學生，凱，你才是。

story.en: Ms. Reed gives you a long talk about taking responsibility. You miss your next bus too.
story.zh: 瑞德老師跟你談了很久關於負起責任的事。結果你連下一班公車也錯過了。

fail.why: It's not my fault. 聽起來在推卸責任。就算不是你的錯，也先道歉再說明：Sorry. My bus was twenty minutes late.。

lines.en: I see. Maybe try an earlier bus on rainy days?
lines.zh: 了解。下雨天也許可以搭早一班的公車？

choices.en: I will. It won't happen again.
choices.tip: It won't happen again. 是道歉時表示會改進的固定說法，用未來式 won't。

lines.en: It doesn't? But... it just happened today.
lines.zh: 不會發生？可是……今天就發生了啊。

story.en: Ms. Reed tries to understand your timeline. You both end up more confused than before.
story.zh: 瑞德老師努力理解你的時間線。最後你們兩個都比剛才更混亂。

fail.why: 承諾以後不會再犯要用未來式：It won't happen again.。現在式 doesn't 聽起來像在描述事實，跟今天剛發生的事矛盾。

choices.en: OK. Can I join online when it rains?
choices.zh: 好。下雨天我可以線上上課嗎？

lines.en: Online? Kai, this isn't a weather problem.
lines.zh: 線上？凱，這不是天氣的問題。

story.en: Ms. Reed says no. Maple Bay gets rain two hundred days a year, so you'd never come to school.
story.zh: 瑞德老師說不行。楓灣一年下兩百天雨，照這樣你根本不用來學校了。

fail.why: 老師給建議時，先接受並承諾改進，不要轉移話題討價還價。說 I will. It won't happen again.。

lines.en: Good. And here's the quiz you missed. You can take it now.
lines.zh: 很好。這是你錯過的小考，現在可以補考。

story.en: You finish the quiz and get nine out of ten. The next rainy morning, you're the first one in class.
story.zh: 你寫完小考，拿到十題對九題。下一個雨天早上，你是全班第一個到的。

notes.explain: 遲到時的標準道歉。上課中只要簡短說這句，安靜入座，下課再解釋原因。

example.en: Sorry I'm late. The traffic was terrible.
example.zh: 抱歉我遲到了，路上大塞車。

notes.zh: 過去式 + so 說明因果
notes.explain: 解釋已經發生的事要用過去式。so 前面是原因，後面是結果。

example.en: I missed the bus, so I took a taxi.
example.zh: 我錯過公車，所以搭了計程車。

notes.explain: 道歉時表示會改進的固定說法。won't 是 will not，表示對未來的承諾。

example.en: I'm really sorry. It won't happen again.
example.zh: 真的很抱歉，不會再發生了。

notes.explain: pour 是「倒、傾瀉」，It's pouring. 就是傾盆大雨。不要說 The rain is very big.。

example.en: Take an umbrella. It's pouring outside!

notes.explain: 英語文化重視「道歉加原因加改進」，不需要長篇解釋或寫悔過書。過度道歉反而會讓氣氛尷尬。

example.en: Sorry, I forgot. I'll send it tonight.
example.zh: 抱歉我忘了，今晚寄給你。
